text: in the Trading Card Game.]] Steam elementals are a type of elementals.
Shifting Naaru Sliver is an epic trinket best suited for tanks.
Steamwheedle Fizzy Spirits is an alcoholic beverage available during the Feast of Winter Veil seasonal event.
Steel Gate Excavators are dwarves located at Steel Gate in Howling Fjord.

Steel Gate is an excavation site located just east of the Apothecary Camp and north of Westguard Keep in Howling Fjord. Due to the digging the river that ran through here has been blocked up and no longer make its way to the sea. According to the the brothers Bronzebeard, the statue there is in surprisingly good condition, considering it's got a river flowing over it.
The Steel Ribbing drops from any vrykul in Baleheim or Nifflevar in the Howling Fjord.

Steeljaw's Caravan was a caravan attempting to travel over a sacred taunka burial ground, found in northern Borean Tundra, south of Bor'gorok Outpost. It was led by Force-Commander Steeljaw, now dead, he disturbs the remaining taunka spirits on the land. It's unknown what the actual burial site is called, if it was ever named.
Stefan Vadu is a human death knight and a quest giver found at Ebon Watch in Zul'Drak. He also appears later at Light's Hammer in Icecrown Citadel. He is the owner of the frost wyrm Persistence.
Steam Frogs are frog critters located in and around the ponds on the Flood Plains in the Borean Tundra. They are surrounded by clouds of steam.
Steam Pump Flotsams can be found in any of the lakes of Zangarmarsh. Content includes scroll case, crates & pump flotsam. Crates generally have Fel Iron Ore or Netherweave Cloth in them.

Steam Springs are hot springs located west of Taunka'le Village and east of the Geyser Fields in Borean Tundra. This area is filled with steam elementals. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that the area is still occupied by hostile robots.

Steam Cloud is a gas cloud that occurs in areas humid areas such as in Sholazar Basin and the Geyser Fields in Borean Tundra. It can be harvested by engineers using a Zapthrottle Mote Extractor, turning into varying amounts of and .
Steamcaller's Totem drops from the Flame Leviathan in the 25-man version of Ulduar. This item is also sold by the following vendors in Dalaran for : * *
Stephan Franks is a Forsaken reagent vendor located at New Agamand in the Howling Fjord.
Step Into The Arena is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning a ranked arena match.

Steelfeather is a hippogryph found near Fort Wildervar in the Howling Fjord. Characters investigate Steelfeather in the quest We Call Him Steelfeather where it is found out that the "he" is a "she" who is currently tending her nest in the peaks. Only hunters with the secrets of taming feathermanes can catch her.
As of patch 3.1.0, Siege Engines now have Steam Pressure as a resource type, replacing Energy.
Steelforged Defenders are iron dwarves located in the Flame Leviathan's gauntlet within Ulduar.

:Sometimes, when the world outside is frozen waste, a steaming bowl of chicken soup is just the thing to warm up a cold crusader. Brought to Icecrown by the Argent Crusade to fortify them in their campaign against the Lich King, this soup will ward off all manner of evils.
Steam Ragers are steam elementals found in the Steam Springs area of the Borean Tundra.
Stefan's Steel Toed Boot is provided as an objective for Kickin' Nass and Takin' Manes.
__NOTOC__ Steen Horngrass is a tauren stable master located outside of the Sunreaver Pavilion in Icecrown. He's got a pet warp stalker named Froggle. He was present during Death Rising.

This portable battering ram knocks down doors, breaks large objects, and pries gates open with it optional crowbar attachment. It is reliable but not useful on stealth missions, given the staggeringly loud sound it makes.
Steel-Tipped Snowboots are a reward for completing Valkyrion Must Burn.

Stephanie Johnson, (alias Lylirra, previous Syndri), is a Blizzard employee, Community Manager for the US World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/ forums], and Community Manager and Community Team Lead for Overwatch (previously Diablo III).
Sten's First Aid Kit is a quest item for Aid for the Wounded.

The Steamwheedle Sharks is a footbomb team of goblins belonging to the Steamwheedle Cartel. They are first seen on Kezan playing (and winning) a game of footbomb against the Bilgewater Buccaneers. They are later hired by Trade Prince Gallywix to work in and defend the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles. They were attacked by the Bilgewater Cartel goblins who decided to act against Gallywix. It is unknown how they all fit on his yacht. They were said to be better equipped than the Bilgewater Buccaneers.
Steelspark Station is a small Gnomeregan Covert Ops camp located in the northwestern area of Land's End Beach in Tanaris.
Steelwing Pendant is a quest reward from It's Ours Now (Alliance).
__NOTOC__ Steelbender's Masterpiece drops from Karsh Steelbender in Blackrock Caverns.
__NOTOC__ Steamwheedle Bruisers are goblin guards located at top of Horde zeppelin towers in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn and in Tirisfal Glades.
Stefan's Horn is used to call Stefan Vadu while at the Reliquary of Pain for Infiltrating Voltarus.
Steelfury's Weapon Emporium is a weapon shop found in the Commons of Ironforge.

Stephen Browman was the owner of Browman Mill in the Eastern Plaguelands, but was killed and raised as a ghoul (Smokey LaRue states he's a zombie) in service to the Scourge. Smokey needs him killed for his wrappings.

The first steam horses were built by the Alliance for patrols traveling the arid savannah of the Barrens in eastern Kalimdor, where grazing was sparce. The rider sits in the saddle atop the four-legged machine and guides it just as he would a living mount. The rear of the steam horse includes a spacious compartment for cargo and gear. Ryon Quarvel has one.

Steam warriors are tinkers who take to the battlefield in walking suits of armor. Though a steam warrior's personal set of armor is endlessly improved and modified, steam warriors in need of money have been known to construct and sell basic sets of armor. These have no projectile weapons, but do possess axe blades that fold out from wrists to allow melee combat..
Stephan Kebbel is a Gilnean fishing supplies vendor for the Gilnean town of Surwich in the Blasted Lands.
Stek Orespazz is a goblin blacksmithing vendor located in Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

Stebben Oreknuckle is a Dark Iron dwarf quest giver located at Chiselgrip in the Burning Steppes. In addition to aid in the struggle against the Dark Iron dwarves, he will ask players to help train the Chiseled Golems in the area.

__NOTOC__ Steamwheedle Sharks are shredders that have been modified to play a version of football, or footbomb. They are initially encountered on Kezan during the Necessary Roughness quest, and are later employed by at the Bilgewater Lumber Yard on the Lost Isles as a clear-cutting crew.
Steam Fiends can be found on the Singing Pools on the Wandering Isle.
Steamrigger Mechanics are leper gnomes found in the Steamvault.
Steelbender Doshu is a pandaren blacksmith found at Zouchin Village in Kun-Lai Summit.
Steepmaster Puoba is a jinyu at Pearlfin Village in the Jade Forest.
Stephanie Krutsick is an archaeology trainer located in the Alliance town of Lor'danel in Darkshore.
__NOTOC__ Steamed Crab Surprise is created with Way of the Steamer (600); taught by Yan Ironpaw in the Valley of the Four Winds. This item is created 5 at a time.
Steepmaster Tira is a pandaren found in an inn in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle.
The Steel-Backed Hauberk is a reward from the following quests: * Peace at Last * Justice Dispensed
Stella Boomboom is a goblin stable master located at the Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.
__NOTOC__ Steamed Scorpion is created with Cooking (1); taught by Recipe Idea: Steamed Scorpion.
Steamscar Warriors are saberon located in Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.
Steamscar Primalists are saberon located in Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond.
__NOTOC__ Steeltusk is an elekk found at a ruined Frostwolf clan camp southeast of the Mor'gran Logworks in northeastern Talador. With the armored elekk is Gokrum Wolfgrinder.
Steamwheedle Wagon Bomb can be obtained from the Blingtron 5000 Gift Package rewarded from Blingtron 5000 (quest).
The Steamwheedle Preservation Society (the SPS) is locked in a rivalry with Harrison Jones and traditional archaeologists.
Steamworks Sausage Grill is purchased for from the Brewfest vendors.
Stellar Flare is a Balance druid talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Wild Surges.
__NOTOC__ Stele is a draenei located at the Embaari Village in . She is healing the injured Teluuna Researchers.
Sten is a guard in Stormwind Keep. He was seen wondering which of the two Varians is the true one.
Steelforged Essence is crafted with Blacksmithing (1); taught by Plans: Steelforged Essence.
Steamwheedle Excavators are goblins found in Warspear's Microshop of Ashran.
Steelsnout is a helboar found in northeastern Tanaan Jungle.
Stealthman 54 is created with Engineering (1); taught by Draenor Engineering (item). It can also be obtained from the Blingtron 5000 Gift Package rewarded from Blingtron 5000 (quest).
Steamscar Rise is the home of the Steamscar Saberon in Gorgrond.
Stephen Hadeed Jr. is the voice of Setesh in World of Warcraft.
Steamy Romance Novel Kit is created with Inscription (800); taught by Recipe: Steamy Romance Novel.
Stellagosa's Silver Coin is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.
Stellagosa is an optional breadcrumb quest only available when you turn in The Consumed and The Withered, and did not take Stellagosa's quest Runas the Shamed (quest).
Stephanie Shen is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
__NOTOC__ The Steelbound Harness teaches you how to summon a Steelbound Devourer, a fel core hound mount.
Stephen Stanton is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.

__NOTOC__ Steelclaw Vale is a glade found in southwestern Val'sharah. The Sleeper's Barrow is found in the southern end while the northern side houses a small inn. The western side leads to the Smolderhide Thicket. The crazed Smolderhide furbolgs have invaded the Steelclaw Vale causing mayhem.

Steamwheedle Refugees are goblin refugees of the Steamwheedle Cartel. They were presumably displaced by the Cataclysm. During the Legion Invasions, they could be found injured or being cornered by demons. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.

Stealthy Assassins are friendly rogues of several races that are at the Legion Invasion locations. Once saved, they can help the adventurers. They can only be saved by Horde adventurers. They are also present on the Broken Isles during the Legion Assaults.
Steel Gate Archaeologists are dwarven members of the Explorers' League located in the Howling Fjord.
Steamscar Vessel is a reward from the following quests: *Saberon Population Reduction *Steamscar "Reagents"
:This flavorful Kun-Lai-style noodle soup is made from mutton and goat milk. As Brother Noodle says, "Steam goat noodle: Number One! Come fill belly with noodle, yes! Very good!"
Steelback's Claw dropped from Steelback at the Steam Pools in Feralas.

Stephan Frost is a former employee of Blizzard Entertainment and worked as Senior Design Producer for World of Warcraft. He left Blizzard to pursue "a big opportunity". His last day was September 22, 2017.

The Steamscar tribe is a group of saberon based in Steamscar Rise in Gorgrond and led by Ashripper. They are known to be notorious looters and took :Dionor's Death Bloom and herb bundles. Both Altauur and Rakthoth worked with Azeroth's adventurers against the Steamscar, reducing their numbers and obtaining the stolen items. They also attacked Garrison outposts in Gorgrond. A sole Steamscar saberon sold out his rival to the armies of the Garrisons after he has been caught skulking around Garrison walls and made a deal with them to let him go.
Sten's Log belonged to Captain Sten, from what is now Tideskorn Harbor.

Steelgrass, while outwardly appearing to be soft, is as strong as metal. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm shaped it into a chest which contained the Idol of Remulos. A normal night elf would have been unable to either cut through it or pry open the bound lid.

The Stein of Grog is provided as an objective for Captured and Enraptured.
Steamed Hamhocks is a shop located in Hook Point in Boralus.
Stephen's Food Court is located in Hook Point in Boralus. It is run by the Stephens family.
Steaming Furies are steam elementals located in Un'Goro Crater.

Steelforged Greataxe is created with Blacksmithing (1); taught by Plans: Steelforged Greataxe.
Steelweaver Javae is a Zandalari troll located in the Zocalo in Dazar'alor. She was also present during the Battle of Dazar'alor.
Steamy Essence drops from Steam Elementals in Tiragarde Sound.
Steamed Clams are contained inside An Unforgettable Luncheon, itself contained in the Discarded Lunchbox in Brennadam Square.
Steelforged Shield is created with Blacksmithing (100); taught by Plans: Steelforged Shield.
Steelforged Saber is created with Draenor Blacksmithing (1); taught by Plans: Steelforged Saber.
Stephen Critchlow is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Steamwheedle Glider Pilots are goblins located in . They can be seen using spyglasses, preparing marshmallows, or just chilling.

The Stellar Refraction Device is located beneath the elevator in the Halls of Origination. Heading down stairs through the northern passage will allow the device to be operated. Activating it will cause a myriad of colored runes to appear in the area around the central device. In between the runes, different types of refractors can be found: Angular Stellar Refractor, Jagged Stellar Refractor, Round Stellar Refractor.
Steaming Crab Meat is looted from Brineclaw Meat at Redsilt Wash in Vol'dun. It also drops from the following Brineclaw makrura: *Brineclaw Pincer *Brineclaw Oracle *Brineclaw Snapper
The Stealthy Vagrant is an inn located at Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound.
Steamwheedle Scout is a goblin that would appear in Tanaris during the Legion Invasions.
Stellagosa's Breath is a quest reward from Saving Stellagosa.
Steeljaw Grizzlies are bears located in the Fields of the Eternal Hunt in the Halls of Valor.

]] The Steamy Romance Novels, collectively known as the Steamy Romance saga, are a series of erotic novels and in-game book items that were first introduced in The Burning Crusade, with new entries added with successive expansions. Most of the books, which are filled with double entendres and "tawdry tales of carnality", are centered around the paladin Marcus and his encounters with various love interests. Francis Serbacon, Bill Spearshaker, and Noah Scribeson all claim to be the author of the series. However, when encountered by scribes, both Francis and Bill claim to have grown tired of writing the novels and offer the scribe the opportunity to continue the series themselves using a Steamy
Steelbore Cannoneers are dwarves located on the Alliance Airship in Vol'dun and Zuldazar during the Faction Assaults.
Steeped Kelp Tea is sold by Asme Seapearl and Enizo in Nazjatar.
Steel Thunder Chestbrace is a quest reward from Steel Thunder.
Steelforged Hammer is created with Draenor Blacksmithing (1); taught by Plans: Steelforged Hammer.
Steelforged Dagger is a crafted with Blacksmithing (1); taught by Plans: Steelforged Dagger.

The Steamway is an underground passage located in Dazar'alor. It goes from Little Tortolla to Backwater Beach on southeastern Zuldazar. It also appears to be a tortollan hatchery as one of the rooms is filled with plenty of eggs.
Stellar Pylons are crystals summoned by Saba-tok and Nebet the Ascended in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum.
Steelgazer Hide Leggings are a quest reward from Legion world quests or is contained in caches.
Steelgazer Hide Gloves are a quest reward from Legion world quests or is contained in caches.
Steel-Plated Arachnid Exoskeleton is looted from Loose Parts after defeating Arachni in Vol'dun during Faction Assaults. It is used to create the Rebuilt Mechanical Spider.
Steelbound Heater Shield is a quest reward from Breaking the Hopebreakers.

The Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit is a goblin organization mentioned by Zeggon Botsnap. By its name and representatives, the organization revolves around combatants in arenas across Azeroth and Outland.
Stellarwasps are fireflies located at the Banks of Life in Ardenweald.
Steelskin Linebreaker's Head drops from Steelskin Linebreakers in Maldraxxus.
Steelscale Cloudstriders were cloudstriders located in western Bastion. They were replaced by Shimmering Cloudstriders.
Steelscale Stags were cloudstriders located in western Bastion. They were replaced by Silverplume Stags.
Steelpin Wilhelm is a Maldraxxi gladiator located at the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus.
Steamscale Incinerator is a mechanical dragon mount. On purchase, it becomes automatically unlocked in the mounts tab.
__NOTOC__ Steelhide Leather Belts are crafted with Leatherworking (1).
The Steelhide Leather Harness is crafted with Leatherworking (1).
__NOTOC__ Steelhide Leather Straps are crafted with Leatherworking (1). This item is created six at a time.

Steelmaw's Stompers drop from Durkath Steelmaw in Camp Thornscar in the Spires of Arak.
Steeltusk's Steel Tusk drops from Steeltusk at a ruined Frostwolf clan camp southeast of the Mor'gran Logworks in northeastern Talador.
Steelfur Chargers are rams located on the outer cliffs south of the Temple of Humility in Bastion.
__NOTOC__ Steelspine Veterans are abominations located in Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus.
Steelsnout's Steely Hide drops from Steelsnout in northeastern Tanaan Jungle.
Stealthlings are spiders summoned by Brood Ambushers in Plaguefall.
The Steel Spade is provided as an objective for Troll Patrol: Can You Dig It?.
Steamwheedle Supplies are looted from Steamwheedle Crates in Tanaris.
Steel Reinforced Bracer is a quest reward from Protect the Frontier.
Steel-Patched Armbands are a quest reward from Raptor Scraps.
Steelgut's Undermail is a quest reward from Drowned Sorrows.
Stem-Laced Boots are a quest reward from Greasing the Wheel.
Steelskin Brutalizers are abominations located in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Steelskin Linebreakers are abominations located in Maldraxxus.
Steelskin Reader is an abomination located in the Spearhead in Maldraxxus.
Steelring's Foolproof Dynamite is provided as an objective for Danger! Explosives!.
Steelspine Vanguards are abominations located in Maldraxxus.
Steamwheedle Bughunters are goblin located Bootlegger Outpost in Tanaris.
Steelspine Wallbreakers are abominations located in Maldraxxus.
Stellar Inspiration is a conduit for balance druids. It drops from Mordretha, the Endless Empress in the Theater of Pain and Painsmith Raznal in the Sanctum of Domination.
Stella Stargazer is a nightborne located in the Waking Shores. She can be found with Rocky Dustbeard next to a Crashed Gyrocopter. They are under attack by Turbulent Gusts.
Stealthy Elven Port is sold by Outfitter Tipech at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores for .
Steam Scarabs are beetles located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Steamed Crabs are crabs located in melted glacier pools at Vakthros Range in the Azure Span.
Steiz is a blue drakonid serving as the quartermaster of the Cobalt Assembly found in the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span.
Steelcliff Guards are drakonid located in Steelcliff Rampart in Thaldraszus.
Steelcliff Lifekeepers are red dragonspawn located in Steelcliff Rampart in Thaldraszus.
Steelcliff Menders are green dragonspawn and bronze dragonspawn located in Steelcliff Rampart in Thaldraszus.
Steelcliff Ohuna are ohuna located at Steelcliff Rampart in Thaldraszus.
__NOTOC__ Steam Scaulder are water elementals summoned by the Primalists in the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Steel-Lined Locking System is sold for by Gill the Drill at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
Steam Jets are water elementals located at Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Steamed Scarab Steak is sold by Xemah at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus for .

SteelSeries is a company that create performance enhancing gaming gear, created for and by leading professional gamers. They are gaming partners with Blizzard Entertainment Inc. and have released various products for World of Warcraft. They made a line of Wrath of the Lich King-themed peripherals: the Zboard Limited Edition Gaming Keyboard, Qck Limited Edition Lich King Exclusive Gaming Surface, and 5C Limited Edition Frost Wyrm Exclusive Gaming Surface. All are made with high-quality materials and feature artwork from Wrath of the Lich King. They also released the World of Warcraft MMO Gaming Mouse, featuring 15 programmable buttons, ergonomic design, 16 million illumination options, and ad

Stitches is an abomination found in Duskwood. Abercrombie the Embalmer creates Stitches as a "gift" for Lord Ello Ebonlocke, the mayor of Darkshire — sending him to terrorize the town. This will occur when you start the quest The Embalmer's Revenge. It will now spawn outside a phased version of the town hall in which the Night Watch attacks him. As of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Stitches is a fight in the Brawler's Guild. He is a juror during :The Brawlpub Trial and :The Brawl'gar Trial.
Stinging Viper is a one hand mace dropped by Lord Pythas in the Wailing Caverns.
Stinger of Ayamiss drops from Ayamiss the Hunter in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.
__NOTOC__ Stitched Spewers are abominations found in Naxxramas.
Stockade Pauldrons is a world drop item, intended for tanks.

The Stockpile is a cave where Chief Anders, Chief Gaulus, Chief Miranda, and Chief Esquivel keep their war-waging equipment. It is a non-instanced dungeon located at the back of the Kurzen's Compound in Northern Stranglethorn.

The Stillpine tribe is a tribe of furbolgs inhabiting the Azuremyst Isles. They are led by High Chief Stillpine who can be found at Stillpine Hold. Since the arrival of the Draenei the Stillpine tribe have allied themselves with them and the Alliance.

Stings are nature-based poisons that are exclusive to hunters. * Serpent Sting - Causes Nature damage over 18 seconds. * Chimaeral Sting - PvP talent. Stings were previously like warlock curses, with only one being applied at a time to a target by the hunter, and a variety of different effects which were useful in PvP.

Stillpine the Younger is a furbolg quest giver located at Stillpine Hold in Azuremyst Isle. He is the son of High Chief Stillpine, and thus heir to the chieftaincy of the Stillpine tribe. Stillpine is one of the many who journey to Blood Watch to celebrate the hero of Bloodmyst and Azuremyst.
Stoicism was a former Paladin talent in the Protection tree.
Stinging Bow is a Level 50 quality Bow that improves Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Stillpine Shocker is a quest reward from Saving Princess Stillpine.
Stillpine Defender is a quest reward from The Prophecy of Akida.
Stillpine Hold is a quest chain centered around the furbolg of Stillpine Hold. The chain starts in Azure Watch, on Azuremyst Isle. is a prerequisite for this quest chain.
Stewed Trout is created with Outland Cooking (20); taught once only by Kylene in Shattrath, now by all trainers.

This quest starts the Narain's Scrying Goggles portion of the Blue Scepter Shard fork of The Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain, to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Players must have completed Translating the Ledger before will offer this quest.

Steven was a villager and son of Alicia. The family lived in a farmhouse in a village between the Silver Hand encampment and Strahnbrad. Alicia and Little Timmy escaped Lordaeron with the Human Expedition and now reside in Theramore. It is unknown if Steven escaped too.

Stitches' Femur is a quest reward from The Embalmer's Revenge. This item drops from Stitches in Duskwood.
__NOTOC__ Stitched Horrors are abominations found at Corin's Crossing in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Stillpine Ambassador Frasaboo is a furbolg quest ender located in Blood Watch on Bloodmyst Isle.
A race of giant humanoid creatures resembling stick bugs fought in the War of the Ancients. They swayed gently in the wind.
Stewards are humans, blood elves, and high elves found in the Librarium in the Nexus.
__NOTOC__ Stinkbeard is a magnataur lord from the Dragonblight. He is the second boss of the Amphitheater of Anguish.

The Steppe of Life is a grassy area located south of the Forest of Shadows in southwestern Wintergrasp. It is inhabited by Living Lashers, and now bigger Mature Lashers, which are camouflaged as large flowers and will attack players if they get too close to them. These lashers, like players, drop Alliance Herb Pouch or Horde Herb Pouch (depending on your faction) for the quests: *A Rare Herb *Healing with Roses

The Stick is provided as an objective for Mounting Up. To use this, you need to first equip it (as a two-handed weapon item). Target the horse you wish to lure, and use the stick. Using the stick to lure a horse requires/consumes one Wild Carrot.
Stokin' the Furnace (25 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Ignis the Furnace Master in 4 minutes on 25-player mode.
__NOTOC__ Stinky is one of Rotface and Festergut's pet plague-dogs, along with Precious. He is a miniboss in The Plagueworks of Icecrown Citadel.
Stoic Mammoth Hide drops from Stoic Mammoths in the Valley of Ancient Winters to the west of Dun Niffelem in the Storm Peaks.
Sternhorn's Shield is a quest reward from A Line in the Dirt (Horde).

The Steps of Fate is a grand stairway leading from the Cursed Landing to the Halls of Origination in Uldum. The Steps of Fate have been occupied by the Amathet, a group of tol'vir who believe only they can protect the titans' works. They are unearthing artifacts.
Stewed Rabbit is sold by several different vendors, typically innkeepers and Food and Drink provisioners in Cataclysm zones, and inside Zul'Gurub and Dragon Soul.
The Sticky Silk Gland is an objective of daily Tol Barad Peninsula quest A Sticky Task.
Stitches' Stitchings is a quest reward from The Embalmer's Revenge.
Stinky Sharpshiv is a goblin rogue trainer found in Azshara like most of the Bilgewater Cartel goblins. He replaces his sister, Slinky as a trainer.
Stitched Warsong Horrors can be found near Kel'Thuzad in the Plains of Nasam in the Borean Tundra.
Steppebeasts are mushan located at Fire Camp Osul in Townlong Steppes. These easily-scared beasts serve as a source of food for the yaungol army, alongside some Long-Haired Yaks.

Stikwad is a goblin quest giver and member of the Earthen Ring at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale. He enlists the aid of Horde adventurers to assist Arctanus, The Vortex, and Core against their fellow elemental Lord Magmathar.

The Stinging Trail runs from the southern end of the Clutches of Shek'zeer, past Kypari Ik, the Duskroot Fen, and Kypari Zar, then connects either to Soggy's Gamble, Mazu's Overlook, the Briny Muck, or the Amberglow Hollow.

__NOTOC__ -corrupted since 5.4.]] Stillwater Crocolisks dwell along the river towards Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Ren Firetongue used to send adventurers to kill them, in revenge for their attempt to bite his foot off. These crocolisks have since become corrupted by the sha energies.
Stingers are looted from Sting Rays in the Sandy Shallows of the Krasarang Wilds.
